annotations.title: Find the product behind a supplier link

description: Use this when a seller pastes a supplier product link (Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, Apliiq, Artelo, CustomCat, Fourthwall, Inkthreadable or merchOne). Returns the matching POD Benchmark product and any colour the link selects, ready for compare_product with yourSupplier set to that supplier. It never opens the link.

url.description: A supplier's product page, such as a Printify or Printful product link.

name: resolve_supplier_link

matches.description: The matched product, or every candidate when ambiguous; empty when nothing matched.

canonicalProductId.description: The product's id, to pass to compare_product.

choices.description: What the link selects, ready for compare_product `choices`; empty for the product's usual choice.

supplierId.description: The supplier the link points at.

supplierProductName.description: The product's name at that supplier; null when unknown.

url.description: The product's page on POD Benchmark.

message.description: What to do next, in words.

status.description: resolved when one product matched, ambiguous when several did, otherwise why nothing matched.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: Find the product behind a supplier link
